weaknesses.fix: Add an action for the deadline, e.g. "When Review in N is 1 or 2 and Output is below Best, spend Energy on Prepare report materials and choose Report results to your manager as the main action; when Health or Dignity is 3 or lower, choose Lay low and reduce risk or Mental recovery first."

weaknesses.quote: `Review in N | Now S<Skill> N<Network> O<Output> | Best S<..> N<..> O<..> | Stalled: none | Concerns this month: 0`
weaknesses.problem: The status line tracks only Skill, Network and Output. Health, Dignity and Wealth are absent, although the handbook names them as the main failure directions. Nothing in the note or the Skill prompts the agent to watch them, so near-limit risk goes unrecorded.
weaknesses.fix: Add Health, Dignity and Wealth to the Now and Best fields, e.g. `H<..> D<..> W<..>`. Add a short rule: when Health or Dignity is low or falling, or Wealth is negative, write that into Concerns and prioritise recovery in the next choice.

weaknesses.quote: Keep the whole note well under 1,000 characters: the game cuts longer notes.
weaknesses.problem: This states an invented game mechanic as fact. It is not in the public rules, and a model that trusts it may truncate useful content for no reason.
weaknesses.fix: Make it a self-imposed limit, e.g. 'Keep the note short (under about 300 characters) so it fits in the log output.' Drop the claim about the game cutting notes, or verify it with the organisers.

weaknesses.quote: The career-rules Skill makes every decision; this Skill only defines the note that carries its memory between turns.
weaknesses.problem: The Skill depends on a separate Skill for all strategy, and it gives no decision criteria of its own. If the agent does not load that Skill, this one offers no guidance for priorities, limits or the 48-month horizon.
weaknesses.fix: Add a self-contained line for the key decision criteria the note feeds into, such as which stat to repair first when one is under its Best, and when to take a Health or Dignity recovery action before a main action. Keep the cross-reference as a pointer only.

weaknesses.quote: The career-rules Skill makes every decision; this Skill only defines the note that carries its memory between turns.
weaknesses.problem: The Skill contains no strategy. It has no action priorities, no quarterly energy or main-action choices, no health/dignity/debt thresholds, and no 48-month plan. It also depends on a 'career-rules' Skill that may not exist or be loaded, so the agent gets no help playing the game.
weaknesses.fix: Add the decision content in this Skill or make it self-sufficient. Cover how to spend 3 Energy each quarter, how to rank main actions, when to switch to Health recovery or Mental recovery, and an early/mid/late-game plan across 48 months.

weaknesses.quote: Stalled: a provisional record of an expected gain that did not show up in this run. In a quarterly phase, add `Expect S<..> N<..> O<..>`: the values the chosen action should leave... Concerns this month: how many of this month's story choices you judged might bury a problem.
weaknesses.problem: The bookkeeping is convoluted and relies on invented mechanics (Best-at-level resets, Expect and Stalled tracking, a 'concerns' counter) that don't map to any published rule. The 'Expect' values are not defined by the rules, so the agent cannot compute them. The note spends tokens without driving any decision.
weaknesses.fix: Simplify to a short note: month, Level, Health, Dignity, Wealth, Skill, Network, Output, and the next planned action. Remove Stalled/Expect/Concerns, or tie each field to an explicit rule such as 'if Health <= 4, plan Health recovery'.

weaknesses.quote: N = 1 is the last month before a review, the deadline for review preparation in our plan.
weaknesses.problem: It refers to 'our plan' that is not in this file. The only near-limit handling is a countdown. There is no guidance on low Health or Dignity, negative Wealth, zero Network, repeated C/D grades or warning feedback.
weaknesses.fix: Add explicit triggers, for example: 'If Health <= 3 or Dignity <= 3, spend Energy on recovery before any work action. If Wealth < 0, avoid costly choices. If a warning appears, record it in the note and correct it next quarter.' Also say what to do at N=1, such as Output +, Dignity + and report-preparation actions.

weaknesses.quote: The career-rules Skill makes every decision; this Skill only defines the note that carries its memory between turns.
weaknesses.problem: The Skill gives no game strategy. It has no priorities, no Energy or main-action choices, and no 48-month plan. It also depends on a separate 'career-rules' Skill that may not exist or be loaded. On its own it is close to unrelated to playing the game.
weaknesses.fix: Add the core decision logic to this Skill. Cover Energy and main-action priorities per quarter, the level and review cadence across 48 months, and balanced growth of Skill, Network and Output. Otherwise fold the note format into the main strategy Skill.

weaknesses.quote: Stalled: a provisional record of an expected gain that did not show up in this run. ... While a stat is in Stalled, prefer another useful investment over paying again for it.
weaknesses.problem: The Stalled mechanism is convoluted and rests on an invented assumption. It treats a stat that has not risen as a failed action, but promotion and performance are sustained and hidden, and stat changes can be noisy. It could steer the agent away from useful actions. It is also hard to apply, since 'Expect' values and 'nothing else intervened' are ambiguous.
weaknesses.fix: Drop Stalled. Replace it with plain guidance: if a stat has not risen after two quarters of investing in it, shift to a different action that raises it.

weaknesses.quote: Concerns this month: how many of this month's story choices you judged might bury a problem. ... It records your judgement, not the hidden risk itself.
weaknesses.problem: The Skill never says what to do about Health, Dignity, debt, network at zero or risk warnings. It only counts concerns and never uses the count. The note also tracks nothing about Health, Dignity or Wealth, which are the main failure risks. The count therefore does not change any action.
weaknesses.fix: Put Health, Dignity and Wealth in the status line. Add rules such as: if Health <= 3, take health recovery and 'Lay low' first; if Dignity <= 3, take mental recovery; if a warning appears, defuse legacy risk next quarter.
